response.sql:
WITH filtered_films AS (
  SELECT rating, rental_rate, rental_duration
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost <= 20.99
),
rating_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio
  FROM filtered_films
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_value
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT 
  ra.rating,
  ra.avg_ratio,
  ra.avg_ratio - om.mean_value AS difference
FROM rating_averages ra
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE ra.avg_ratio > om.mean_value
ORDER BY ra.rating;

assumptions.assumption: "Replacement-cost cutoff of 20.99" means films where replacement_cost <= 20.99 (at or below the cutoff). The phrasing "cutoff to select films" most naturally reads as selecting up to and including the threshold.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff could instead mean films where replacement_cost > 20.99 (above the threshold, selecting films that exceed the cutoff).
